_doc: Muscle vocabulary v2 shared by the body generator, the engine and exercise data. Three levels: part (leaf) -> muscle -> group. Encoding: vertex attribute _PART_ID = 1 + 2*leaf_index + side (side: 0 = L, 1 = R); 0 = none (head, tendon-only, bone). leaf_index is the position in the 'parts' array: new leaves are only appended, never reordered or removed, or baked models break. Muscle and group are looked up from the leaf (parts[i].muscle -> muscles[].group). A muscle without 'parts' is its own single leaf (parts entry with id == muscle id, no names: inherits the muscle's latin/names/layer); a split muscle's leaves carry their own latin/names and may override 'layer'. v2 replaces v1's _MUSCLE_ID/_DEEP_ID: every muscle mesh carries its own _PART_ID, and 'layer' decides what is surface vs x-ray: superficial = forms the outer surface of a skinless ecorche; intermediate = partly exposed or directly under the superficial layer; deep = fully covered. 'zones' are sub-regions without their own geometry: range = [from, to] as a fraction of the muscle's length measured from its top (proximal/cranial) end along its long axis; referenced as '<muscle>:<zone>'. Geometry source per leaf: data/za_map.json (Z-Anatomy object names, '.l'/'.r' appended per side). Current max code = 238 (fits float32 exactly; exceeds uint8 once there are more than 127 leaves). Names: en only for now; localization adds keys without schema change.
